IS 15964 : 2013 : Digital free to Air Satellite ReceiverICS 33.060.30; 33.160.20; 33.160.25LTD 7Reaffirmed 20221. ScopeThis standard specifies the requirements for digital freeto- air satellite receiver to receive free-to-air multichannel television and radio programmes by using a satellite system2. ReferencesThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreement based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
